Only .ts and .cpp are allowed.' }; fs.unlinkSync(tempFilePath); // Clean up the temporary file return; } const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { exec(command, (error, stdout, stderr) => { // Clean up the temporary file fs.unlink(tempFilePath, (unlinkError) => { if (unlinkError) { console.error('Error deleting temporary file:', unlinkError); } }); if (error) { resolve({ hasError: true, compilerError: stderr.trim() }); } else { resolve({ hasError: false, compilerError: null }); } }); }); ctx.body = result; }); app .use(bodyParser()) .use(router.routes()) .use(router.allowedMethods()); app.listen(5000, () => { console.log('Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:5000'); });
